title: Minimum Operations to Make Array Sum Divisible by K
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, you can decrease any element by one any number of times.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, you can decrease any element by one any number of times. Determine the least number of such operations needed to make the total sum of the array divisible by k.
constraints: One operation decreases any array element by one.
Return the minimum operations needed to make the total array sum divisible by k.
hints: Let total be the current sum.
Each decrement lowers total by exactly one.
The remainder total modulo k is the number of decrements needed to reach the previous multiple.
Fewer decrements leave a positive remainder, so this count is minimal.
editorial: Fewer decrements leave a positive remainder, so this count is minimal.

tests.explanation: The sum is nineteen; decreasing by four reaches fifteen, divisible by five.
The sum is already divisible by five, so zero operations are needed.
